request.description: List every registered query for a workspace. Sort via repeated `sort_by` query params; each entry is `+field` or `-field` (allowed field: deployed_at). Default: `-deployed_at`. Cursor opaque — round-trip `continuation_token` unchanged with the same `sort_by`. Requires `Workspace.view` permission.
